newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore charges British soldiers with robbery.
newsitem.headline: Singapore charges British soldiers with robbery.

text.p: Two British soldiers appeared in a Singapore court on Tuesday charged with robbing a local man of Singapore $43 (US$30), state television reported.
It said John Thomson King, 20, and Richard George Britten, 22, were accused of robbery in the early hours of May 3 while in Singapore for a military exercise.

The two men, who are due to appear in court again on Monday, were offered bail of S$10,000 each. State television did not say whether they were released on bail and gave no further details. US$1 = S$1.43
